summary: Zechariah crowns Joshua, the high priest, in similitude of Christ, the Branch, who will come—Christ will be a priest upon His throne forever.
meta_description: Zechariah crowns Joshua, the high priest, in similitude of Christ, the Branch, who will come—Christ will be a priest upon His throne forever.

footnotes.note12_a: HEB Branch is His name and from beneath Him one shall branch forth and he shall build the temple of Jehovah.
footnotes.note12_b: TG Jesus Christ, Davidic Descent of; Jesus Christ, Prophecies about.
